caption:
No Oil Paneer Tikka Sliders 🔥�
High protein, super satisfying, and zero oil—perfect for an easy meal or snack.

Makes 4 sliders
Calories per slider: 285
Carbs: 30g | Protein: 18g | Fats: 11g

Ingredients:
200g high protein paneer (or swap with tofu/chicken), cubed
marinade: �
4 tbsp thick curd
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp haldi
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp chaat masala
Salt to taste

Pickled onions:
1 onion, sliced
Pinch of salt
4 tbsp vinegar
Optional: 1 chopped chilli

4 pav buns

Green chutney (1 tsp per slider)

Method:
Mix curd + all spices + salt → add paneer → coat well and marinate (10–15 mins or longer if you have time)
Cook on a non-stick pan or air fry till slightly charred

Mix onions with salt + vinegar (and chilli if using) → let sit for a few mins
Assemble: pav + chutney + paneer + pickled onions → close and serve
That’s it. Easy, high protein, and seriously good.
